found.quote: We recommend you attend with a Students’ Union representative, and if you wish to do so, you should contact the Students’ Union as soon as you can to arrange representation.
found.name: Students’ Union representation

found.quote: Study Skills Teams are also here to help if you need refresher support.
found.anchor: How will you help me study with good academic conduct?
found.name: Study Skills Teams

found.quote: In addition to a sanction you will be required to complete an online module about academic conduct and sign a commitment regarding your future study.
found.name: Online module about academic conduct
